notes.title: Version 11.5 update
notes.content: - corrected issue with updated defensive ratings and three point shooting

notes.title: Version 11.4 update
notes.content:
- added new player comparison screen (look for the balance scale icon at top of screen)
- will now allow leagues to carry in any injury information that is entered into default file
- adjustment made to pace adjustment factor to be more impactful
- moved in-game "toasts" from referees to middle of the screen rather than covering up part of the right side coaching area
- added option to commissioner office to allow you to change the min/max/rookie scale contract levels
- added in functionality to connect to DDS:CB22 when it is available

notes.title: Version 11.3
notes.content:
- database changes and updates
- correction to formula for determining defensive ratings

notes.title: Version 11.2
notes.content:
- fixed screens for display of expansion draft
- changed text for coaches to differentiate temperament from personality type
- made fictional leagues have better initial distribution of talent between teams
- fixed issue where players would reject extension offer on final attempt even if demands met

notes.title: Version 11.1 Update
notes.content:
- fixed issue with MP leagues and FA export data for promises
- fixed issue where wrong coach clothing outfit would show on coach offseason FA page and coach card
- fixed issue where box score link was shown in error on player card during the summer prior to summer games
- fixed issue on setting sub matrix by minutes for summer league team where it was only bringing up main roster
- adjustments to player ratings
